topics.title: Introduction to Data Structures and Algorithms
topics.description: What data structures and algorithms are, how ADTs differ from implementations, and how to study DSA for interviews.

topics.title: Time Complexity
topics.description: Counting the work an algorithm does as input grows: loops, nested loops, logarithmic steps and best/average/worst cases.

topics.title: Asymptotic Notation
topics.description: Big-O, Big-Omega and Big-Theta defined precisely, with growth-rate ordering and proofs using constants.

topics.title: Space Complexity
topics.description: Auxiliary versus total space, recursion stack depth, and trading memory for time.

topics.title: Amortized Analysis
topics.description: Average cost per operation over a sequence: dynamic arrays, two-stack queues, monotonic stacks and the aggregate method.

topics.title: Recurrence Relations and the Master Theorem
topics.description: Writing recurrences for recursive code and solving them by unrolling, recursion trees and the Master Theorem.

topics.title: Algorithm Properties: Stable, In-Place, Adaptive, Online
topics.description: What stable, in-place, adaptive and online mean, with examples of algorithms that have or lack each property.

topics.title: DSA Complexity Reference
topics.description: One-page reference of time and space costs for data-structure operations, sorting, searching, graph, string and DP algorithms.

topics.title: Java Toolkit: Arrays, ArrayList and LinkedList
topics.description: Java arrays, the Arrays utility class, ArrayList and LinkedList: internals, costs and interview traps.

topics.title: Java Toolkit: Stack, Queue, Deque and PriorityQueue
topics.description: Stack, Queue, Deque and PriorityQueue in Java: which class to use, method pairs, internals and pitfalls.

topics.title: Java Toolkit: HashMap, HashSet, LinkedHashMap, TreeMap and TreeSet
topics.description: HashMap, HashSet, LinkedHashMap, TreeMap and TreeSet: hashing internals, ordering, navigation methods and equals/hashCode rules.

topics.title: Java Toolkit: Sorting, Comparable and Comparator
topics.description: Arrays.sort and Collections.sort internals, Comparable versus Comparator, multi-key ordering and comparator bugs.

topics.title: Arrays
topics.description: Contiguous storage, index arithmetic, insertion and deletion costs, and the core in-place array techniques.

topics.title: 2D Arrays and Matrices
topics.description: Two-dimensional arrays: traversal orders, neighbours, transpose and rotation, spiral order and in-place tricks.

topics.title: Strings
topics.description: Java strings and StringBuilder, immutability, character counting, palindromes, anagrams and parsing.

topics.title: Linked List
topics.description: Singly and doubly linked lists: node structure, insertion, deletion, traversal and sentinel nodes.

topics.title: Linked List Techniques
topics.description: Reversing, finding the middle, detecting cycles, merging and reordering linked lists with pointer techniques.

topics.title: Stack
topics.description: LIFO stacks with array and linked-list implementations, bracket matching, expression evaluation and monotonic stacks.

topics.title: Queue
topics.description: FIFO queues, circular arrays, deques, priority queues and monotonic queues, with BFS as the main application.

topics.title: Hashing
topics.description: Hash functions, buckets, chaining and open addressing, load factor and resizing, and how Java's HashMap works.

topics.title: Binary Tree
topics.description: Binary tree terminology, types, node representation, height and size, and recursive thinking about trees.

topics.title: Tree Traversals
topics.description: Preorder, inorder, postorder and level-order traversal, recursively and iteratively, and when to use each.

topics.title: Binary Tree Problems
topics.description: Classic tree problems: height, diameter, balance, lowest common ancestor, path sums, views and serialisation.

topics.title: Binary Search Tree
topics.description: The BST ordering property, search, insertion, deletion, validation, successor queries and balance.

topics.title: Heap
topics.description: Binary heaps stored in arrays: sift-up, sift-down, O(n) heapify and Java's PriorityQueue.

topics.title: Heap Applications
topics.description: Using heaps for k-th largest, top-k, running median and merging k sorted lists.

topics.title: Trie
topics.description: Prefix trees for word insertion, search and prefix queries, with arrays or maps for children.

topics.title: Graph
topics.description: Graph terminology, directed and weighted graphs, and adjacency matrix, adjacency list and edge list representations.

topics.title: Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find)
topics.description: Union-find with union by rank and path compression for near-constant-time connectivity and cycle detection.

topics.title: Segment Tree and Lazy Propagation
topics.description: Range queries with point and range updates using segment trees and lazy propagation.

topics.title: Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree)
topics.description: Binary indexed trees for prefix sums with point updates in O(log n), and range-update variants.

topics.title: Sparse Table and Range Minimum Query
topics.description: O(1) range minimum, maximum and gcd queries on static arrays after O(n log n) preprocessing.

topics.title: Recursion
topics.description: Base cases, the call stack, recursion trees, tail recursion and converting recursion to iteration.

topics.title: Linear Search
topics.description: Scanning elements one by one: variants, sentinels, best and worst cases, and when a linear scan is the right choice.

topics.title: Binary Search
topics.description: Halving a sorted search space: iterative and recursive versions, invariants, overflow-safe midpoints and correctness.

topics.title: Binary Search Variations
topics.description: First and last occurrence, lower and upper bounds, rotated arrays, peaks and 2D matrices.

topics.title: Bubble Sort
topics.description: Repeatedly swapping adjacent out-of-order pairs, with early exit; stable, in place, O(n²).

topics.title: Selection Sort
topics.description: Selecting the minimum of the unsorted part each pass; in place, not stable, minimal swaps, O(n²).

topics.title: Insertion Sort
topics.description: Growing a sorted prefix by inserting each element; stable, adaptive, fast on nearly sorted data.

topics.title: Merge Sort
topics.description: Divide, sort halves recursively and merge: stable O(n log n) in every case with O(n) extra space.

topics.title: Quick Sort
topics.description: Partitioning around a pivot (Lomuto and Hoare), pivot choice, O(n log n) expected and O(n²) worst case.

topics.title: Heap Sort
topics.description: Building a max-heap and repeatedly extracting the maximum: in place, O(n log n) guaranteed, not stable.

topics.title: Counting Sort
topics.description: Sorting small integer keys by counting occurrences: O(n + k), stable with prefix sums.

topics.title: Radix Sort
topics.description: Sorting digit by digit with a stable counting sort: LSD and MSD variants, O(d(n + b)).

topics.title: Bucket Sort
topics.description: Distributing uniformly spread values into buckets and sorting each: O(n) average, O(n²) worst.

topics.title: Backtracking
topics.description: Choose, explore, unchoose: generating subsets, permutations and combinations with pruning.

topics.title: Backtracking Problems: N-Queens, Sudoku, Maze, Word Search
topics.description: Constraint-satisfaction search: N-Queens, Sudoku, mazes and word search with effective pruning.

topics.title: Divide and Conquer
topics.description: Splitting into independent subproblems and combining results, analysed with recurrences.

topics.title: Greedy Algorithms
topics.description: Locally optimal choices, the greedy-choice property, exchange arguments and classic greedy algorithms.

topics.title: Greedy Problems: Intervals, Platforms, Gas Station, Jump Game
topics.description: Interval scheduling, minimum platforms, gas station and jump game solved greedily with proofs.

topics.title: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
topics.description: Breadth-first search with a queue: level order, unweighted shortest paths, multi-source and 0-1 BFS.

topics.title: Depth-First Search (DFS)
topics.description: Depth-first search recursively and with a stack: visiting order, discovery and finish times, applications.

topics.title: Graph Traversal Problems: Components, Islands, Flood Fill, Clone Graph
topics.description: Connected components, islands, flood fill, clone graph and similar BFS/DFS applications.

topics.title: Cycle Detection in Graphs
topics.description: Detecting cycles in undirected graphs (parent check, union-find) and directed graphs (three colours, Kahn).

topics.title: Bipartite Graph Check
topics.description: Two-colouring a graph with BFS or DFS, and why a graph is bipartite exactly when it has no odd cycle.

topics.title: Dijkstra's Algorithm
topics.description: Single-source shortest paths with non-negative weights using a priority queue, and why negative edges break it.

topics.title: Bellman–Ford Algorithm
topics.description: Shortest paths with negative edges by repeated relaxation, negative-cycle detection and k-edge limits.

topics.title: Floyd–Warshall Algorithm
topics.description: All-pairs shortest paths by dynamic programming over intermediate vertices in O(V³).

topics.title: Prim's Algorithm (Minimum Spanning Tree)
topics.description: Growing a minimum spanning tree from a vertex with a priority queue; the cut property.

topics.title: Kruskal's Algorithm (Minimum Spanning Tree)
topics.description: Building a minimum spanning tree by sorting edges and joining components with union-find.

topics.title: Topological Sort (DFS and Kahn's Algorithm)
topics.description: Ordering a DAG with DFS finishing times or Kahn's in-degree algorithm, and detecting cycles.

topics.title: Strongly Connected Components (Kosaraju and Tarjan)
topics.description: Kosaraju's and Tarjan's algorithms for strongly connected components and the condensation DAG.

topics.title: Bridges and Articulation Points
topics.description: Finding critical edges and vertices with DFS discovery times and low-link values.

topics.title: Dynamic Programming
topics.description: Optimal substructure and overlapping subproblems, memoisation versus tabulation, and space optimisation.

topics.title: 1D Dynamic Programming
topics.description: One-dimensional DP over prefixes: climbing stairs, house robber, decode ways, word break and LIS-style states.

topics.title: Grid and 2D Dynamic Programming
topics.description: DP on grids and two-dimensional states: unique paths, minimum path sum, maximal square and rolling rows.

topics.title: Knapsack DP (0/1 and Unbounded)
topics.description: 0/1 and unbounded knapsack, subset sum and coin change, with the loop-direction rule for 1D tables.

topics.title: Subsequence DP (LIS and LCS)
topics.description: Longest increasing subsequence (O(n²) and O(n log n)) and longest common subsequence with reconstruction.

topics.title: String DP (Edit Distance, Palindromes, Word Break)
topics.description: Edit distance, palindromic substrings and subsequences, word break and pattern matching as DP over prefixes.

topics.title: Partition and Interval DP
topics.description: Splitting sequences at cut points and solving dp[l][r] intervals: palindrome partitioning, matrix chain, burst balloons.

topics.title: Stock Buy-and-Sell DP (State Machine DP)
topics.description: Buy-and-sell stock problems as state machines: one, unlimited and k transactions, cooldowns and fees.

topics.title: Tree DP
topics.description: Postorder DP on trees with several states per node: house robber III, independent sets, subtree sizes, rerooting.

topics.title: Bitmask DP
topics.description: DP over subsets encoded as bitmasks for travelling salesman, assignment and partition problems with small n.

topics.title: Naive Pattern Matching
topics.description: Brute-force substring search: trying every alignment, its O(n × m) worst case and why faster methods exist.

topics.title: KMP Algorithm
topics.description: Knuth–Morris–Pratt matching with the LPS failure array for guaranteed O(n + m) search, periods and borders.

topics.title: Rabin–Karp Algorithm
topics.description: Rolling hashes for substring search, collisions and verification, and prefix hashes for O(1) substring comparison.

topics.title: Z Algorithm
topics.description: Computing the Z-array in linear time with the Z-box, and using it for pattern matching and periods.

topics.title: Bit Manipulation
topics.description: Bitwise operators, two's complement, Java shift rules and core tricks such as clearing the lowest set bit.

topics.title: Euclidean GCD
topics.description: GCD by repeated remainders in O(log min(a, b)), LCM, and the extended algorithm for Bézout coefficients.

topics.title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
topics.description: Finding all primes up to n in O(n log log n), with smallest-prime-factor and segmented variants.

topics.title: Prime Factorization
topics.description: Trial division in O(√n), smallest-prime-factor factorisation, and divisor counts, sums and Euler's totient.

topics.title: Modular Arithmetic
topics.description: Computing modulo 10⁹ + 7 safely: negative remainders, overflow, modular inverses and binomial coefficients.

topics.title: Fast Exponentiation
topics.description: Exponentiation by squaring in O(log e), modular powers and matrix exponentiation for linear recurrences.

topics.title: Two Pointers
topics.description: Opposite-end and same-direction pointers for pair sums, in-place filtering, partitioning and container problems.

topics.title: Sliding Window
topics.description: Fixed and variable windows over contiguous ranges, updated incrementally in O(n) total.

topics.title: Fast and Slow Pointers
topics.description: Floyd's tortoise and hare for middles, cycles and cycle entrances in lists and implicit sequences.

topics.title: Prefix Sum
topics.description: Running totals for O(1) range sums and, with a hash map, counting subarrays with a target sum.

topics.title: Difference Array
topics.description: O(1) range additions recorded as start and end markers, rebuilt with one prefix sum; 1D and 2D.

topics.title: Hashing Pattern
topics.description: Replacing repeated searches with hash-map lookups: complements, counts, last indices and canonical keys.

topics.title: Binary Search Pattern
topics.description: Recognising monotone yes/no questions and finding their boundary with one consistent binary search template.

topics.title: Binary Search on Answer
topics.description: Searching the range of possible answers with a monotone feasibility check for min-max and max-min problems.

topics.title: Monotonic Stack
topics.description: Keeping a stack in monotone order to answer next/previous greater or smaller queries in O(n).

topics.title: Monotonic Queue
topics.description: A deque of dominant candidates for sliding-window maxima and minima and window-limited DP.

topics.title: Merge Intervals
topics.description: Sorting intervals by start and sweeping once to merge, insert, intersect and find gaps.

topics.title: Top K Elements
topics.description: Size-k heaps and frontier heaps for the k largest, smallest, closest or most frequent items.

topics.title: Greedy Pattern
topics.description: Recognising when a sort key or local rule is provably optimal, and when a counterexample demands DP.

topics.title: Backtracking Pattern
topics.description: State, choices, goal and pruning: a reusable way to enumerate subsets, partitions and constrained arrangements.

topics.title: Divide and Conquer Pattern
topics.description: Spotting split points that make subproblems independent, and combining their answers efficiently.

topics.title: BFS Pattern
topics.description: Modelling states and moves for minimum-step problems, multi-source spreading and state-space BFS.

topics.title: DFS Pattern
topics.description: Reachability, region and component questions solved by DFS with results aggregated on the way back.

topics.title: Topological Sort Pattern
topics.description: Dependency and ordering problems as DAGs: Kahn's algorithm, cycle checks, parallel rounds and critical paths.

topics.title: Union-Find Pattern
topics.description: Merge-only grouping, redundant links and equivalence constraints handled with disjoint sets.

topics.title: Shortest Path Pattern
topics.description: Choosing BFS, 0-1 BFS, Dijkstra, Bellman–Ford or Floyd–Warshall from edge costs, and modelling path objectives.

topics.title: Dynamic Programming Pattern
topics.description: Recognising DP problems and designing state, transition, base cases, order and answer; the DP families.

topics.title: Bit Manipulation Pattern
topics.description: XOR cancellation, per-bit counting, isolating a distinguishing bit and set masks for O(1)-space solutions.

topics.title: Problem-Solving Framework
topics.description: A repeatable process for unfamiliar problems: understand, clarify, examples, brute force, optimise, plan, code, test, analyse.

topics.title: Constraints and Complexity
topics.description: Reading input sizes, value ranges and memory limits to choose a target complexity and spot overflow risks.

topics.title: Brute Force to Optimal
topics.description: Improving a correct brute force step by step by removing repeated work, including Kadane's maximum subarray.

topics.title: DSA Conceptual Questions
topics.description: Explaining why structures and algorithms behave as they do, with model answers from beginner to advanced.

topics.title: DSA Complexity Questions
topics.description: Justifying time and space costs with counting, halving, recurrences and amortized arguments.

topics.title: DSA Output-Based Questions
topics.description: Predicting the exact output of short Java programs: references, overflow, strings, collections and evaluation order.

topics.title: DSA Implementation Questions
topics.description: Implementing data structures and APIs under interview conditions, from array rotation to LRU and LFU caches.

topics.title: DSA Pattern Recognition Questions
topics.description: Mapping problem statements to the right pattern and justifying the choice against alternatives.
